summary: Add st conversations wait: an agent waits up to a deadline for one sender's reply and gets the reply or no reply.

replay.detail: No new claim kinds. The wait reads the event feed at a paced rate and only the messages it names (the mailbox once, for --after), and marks the returned reply read through the existing delivery and read receipts.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Add the st conversations wait command with --as, --from, --after and --timeout (at most 10m). Older daemons answer through the same message and event routes, so no daemon upgrade is required.

downtime.detail: No daemon or seat restart is required.

recovery.detail: No store migration or recovery procedure changes.
